population: All structurally eligible actual forced-span to tail boundaries in the 1440 primary segmented trials. Do not choose examples by quality.
sampling_rule: Use all eligible boundaries. If a measured pilot proves this infeasible, amend before scoring RankCloak outcomes and select payloads by SHA256(seed|payload_name), balanced by payload class, keeping every model and schedule for selected payloads.

windows.left: Up to 32 generator tokens immediately before the true boundary, restricted to visible message tokens. Canonical primary forced spans contain eight tokens.
windows.right: Up to 32 generator tokens immediately after the boundary.
windows.alignment: Use exact pinned prefix detokenization and UTF-8 byte boundaries. Record empty, short, alignment-failed, and truncated cases separately, without outcome-based exclusions.
windows.matching: Match ordinary and shuffled right-window lengths to each recipient boundary. Apply identical word and truncation rules to every arm.

ordinary_controls: Use retained full-message ordinary controls with the same generator and exact prompt context. Take a prefix and place a pseudo-boundary at the recipient forced length. A historical whole-trial control is not automatically a per-segment control when prompts rotate. Choose eligible donor by seeded identity hash, preferring no reuse, then record every reuse.
shuffled_controls: Rotate eligible donor tails within generator, exact prompt, schedule, and forced-length strata in seeded hash order. Require a different payload and sufficient right-window length. Never pair a message with its own tail. Missing matches are unavailable, not cross-topic substitutions.

semantic_relatedness.checkpoint: Original pinned pretrained base encoder, never the fitted RankCloak detector head.
semantic_relatedness.metric: Cosine similarity of normalized attention-masked mean final-layer embeddings, excluding special tokens. This is a proposed semantic proxy and requires pilot validation, not a claim that DeBERTa is a sentence-similarity model.
semantic_relatedness.freeze_requirement: Verify local weight, tokenizer, configuration, and dependency hashes before pilot. No score-driven pooling or layer search.

conditional_compatibility.metric: Mean tail-token log probability given the rendered prompt and left window, with a prompt-only tail score as a within-pair reference. Retain both raw conditional score and context gain.
conditional_compatibility.tokenization: Freeze evaluator tokenization, join convention, tail byte offsets, boundary-straddling token treatment, and empty-tail rejection in tested instrumentation before pilot. Never reuse generator token IDs in another tokenizer.

pilot.selection: Smallest SHA256(seed|boundary_id) in each generator by schedule by six-category cell, at most 36 boundary identities.
pilot.data: Only ordinary versus same-prompt shuffled ordinary transitions for metric validation. RankCloak scores remain blinded and uncomputed.
pilot.validation_rule: Ordinary transitions must exceed shuffled controls for each prespecified higher-is-better metric with a positive payload-bootstrap 95 percent interval. Record failure and amend instrumentation or metric choice before the full analysis if this check fails.
pilot.throughput: Measure actual tokenizer lengths, elapsed CUDA scoring time, batches, and peak memory. Forecast full work from measured counts and length strata, not generation-smoke throughput.

inference.primary_unit: Payload instance, preserving all model, message, schedule, and segment observations.
inference.estimand: Within-boundary paired differences to the declared fixed empirical control corpus. Average segments within trial and repeated observations within payload before the primary overall contrast.
inference.bootstrap: 2000 payload-cluster resamples stratified by artifact class, seed 20260922. Retain the same payload draw across arms and models.
inference.control_reuse: Report donor reuse and donor-payload linkage. Primary intervals are conditional on the fixed reference corpus. Before population-level claims, add multiway recipient/donor payload uncertainty or declare insufficient independent donor support.
inference.exemplars: Select strongest, median, and weakest measured transitions using a declared metric order and seeded tie rule. Display all three and label them illustrative, not participant evidence.

secondary: Exploratory entity-reference continuity with exact extraction rules
Cross-message topic continuity as a separate analysis because multi-topic prompts deliberately rotate
claim_boundary: Automated complementary measures cannot prove how readers perceive the transition. No participant claims and no whole-message likelihood substitution.
